core.title: Chooser of the Slain
core.daily.label: Daily #{n}
rule.return: The living go back. Stamp RETURN.
rule.ran: The drowned belong to Rán. Stamp RÁN.
rule.folkvangr: A worthy soul who matches Freyja's whim of the day is hers. Stamp FÓLKVANGR.
rule.valhalla: The worthy go to Valhalla: fell in battle, weapon in hand. Stamp VALHALLA.
rule.valhalla.fled: The worthy go to Valhalla: fell in battle, weapon in hand, and never fled. Stamp VALHALLA.
rule.hel: Everyone else goes to Hel. Stamp HEL.
law.fever: A fever flush means sickness took them.
law.foam: Sea-foam on the lips means the sea took them.
law.dryLips: Dry lips mean they did not drown.
law.breath: If the feather stirs at their lips, they still breathe.
law.noBreath: If the feather lies still, they are dead.
law.wounded: Fresh wounds mean they fell fighting, or went into the sea fighting.
law.unwounded: No wounds anywhere means no battle took them.
tm.identity.3: They called me {name}. {patronym}, if you're writing it down.
tm.death.battle.1: I held the shield wall at {place} until {foe} broke it. And me.
tm.death.battle.2: Nine of {foe} I felled at {place} before the tenth got lucky.
tm.death.battle.3: Axe to the ribs, holding {place}. Is this Valhalla? It smells like {place}.
tm.death.battle.4: Spear through the gut at {place}. Quick, at least.
tm.death.sickness.1: The coughing sickness. Three weeks of it.
tm.death.sickness.2: Fever. I'd rather not talk about the rest.
tm.death.oldAge.1: I went in my sleep. I'd lost count of the winters. Enough for anyone.
tm.death.drowned.1: The sea took me off {place}. Cold, then nothing.
tm.weapon.yes.1: I died with my {weapon} in my hand.
tm.weapon.yes.2: My {weapon} never left my grip. Check if you like.
tm.weapon.no.1: My {weapon}? Not in my hand at the end, I know that much.
tm.back.no.1: I never turned my back on them. Not once.
tm.flavor.confused: Where are the tables? I was told there would be tables.
tm.flavor.braggart: Write that down. All of it.
tm.flavor.coward: Is there a quieter hall? Somewhere without spears?
rv.huginn.battle: Huginn: Saw this one go down in the fighting at {place}.
rv.huginn.sickness: Huginn: Fever. Carried out of a farmhouse.
rv.huginn.oldAge: Huginn: Died in bed. Very old. Very dull.
rv.huginn.drowned: Huginn: The sea took this one. I watched from the mast.
rv.huginn.fledTrue: Huginn: Watched this one run for the boats.
rv.huginn.fledFalse: Huginn: This one never ran from anything.
rv.huginn.weapon: Huginn: Weapon in hand to the last.
rv.huginn.noWeapon: Huginn: Empty-handed at the end. I looked.
rv.muninn.forgot: Muninn: I... forget. It'll come to me.
q.cause.braggart.confess.1: ...Fine. {truth, select, oldAge {Old age. In my own bed.} other {The coughing sickness.}}
q.cause.braggart.confess.2: But I was planning a glorious death. Next spring.
q.cause.confess.1: All right. It wasn't a battle.
q.cause.drowned.confess.1: The deck was slippery. I went over. There. Happy?
q.grip.confess.1: I may have dropped it. Briefly. At the start.
q.fled.confess.1: They were very large men. I made a tactical decision.
q.fled.coward.excuse.1: I was looking for a better angle. Behind me.
q.any.excuse.1: It was dark. Things happened. Who can say?
p.hold.any.1: I've told you how it was. Saying it louder won't change it.
p.hold.any.2: Same answer as before. It'll be the same answer tomorrow.
p.hold.any.3: That's how it happened. Write it down, Valkyrie.
p.hold.veteran.1: I've faced harder questions with a spear at my throat. My answer stands.
p.hold.braggart.1: Ask anyone who was there. The ones still breathing will tell you the same.
p.hold.honest.1: It's the plain truth. I've no reason to dress it up.
p.hold.coward.1: I-I've told you already. Please. It's true.
p.hold.confused.1: Did I say that? Then... yes. That's what happened. I'm nearly sure.
p.hold.cause.battle.1: It was a battle. There was shouting, and blood, and then there was this queue.
p.hold.cause.battle.braggart.1: A battle! A great one! They'll sing about it. Someone should.
p.hold.grip.weapon.1: It was in my hand. Where else would it be?
p.hold.fled.false.1: My back was never to them. Not for a heartbeat.
p.hold.fled.false.coward.1: I stood. My knees shook, but I stood.
p.detail.grip.weapon.1: And my weapon was in my fist when I fell. Look at my hand if you doubt me.
p.detail.cause.battle.1: I died fighting, too. Not coughing in some bed.
p.detail.woundsFront.1: One wound, and it was in my chest. One was all it took.

ui.appeal.title: An appeal
ui.appeal.body: {name}, whom you sent to {dest} on Day {n}, asks to be judged again.
ui.appeal.plea.VALHALLA: “I never belonged among the einherjar. Look again.”
ui.appeal.plea.FOLKVANGR: “Freyja's meadow was never meant for me. Look again.”
ui.appeal.plea.HEL: “I did not die the death you think I died. Look again.”
ui.appeal.plea.RAN: “The sea never had me. Look again.”
ui.appeal.plea.RETURN: “I am dead, Valkyrie, whatever you think. Look again.”
ui.appeal.plea.TRANSFER: “I never knelt to the clerk's god. Look again.”
ui.appeal.terms: Heard at the desk, with no sun, on Day {n}'s rules. Not every appeal has merit. Right a wrong verdict and its fine and standing come back; turn down an appeal without merit and earn {bonus} rings; decide it wrongly and pay {fine}.

ui.appeal.upheld: Turned down: {name} belonged in {dest}, as you said. {rings, plural, one {# ring} other {# rings}} for holding firm.
ui.appeal.wrong: Decided wrongly: {name} belonged in {dest}. {rings, plural, =0 {} one {You pay # ring.} other {You pay # rings.}}

Each day would bring {souls, plural, one {one soul} other {# souls}} more than the day's own, {warnings, plural, one {one mistake} other {# mistakes}} fewer forgiven before the fines, {wage, plural, one {one ring} other {# rings}} more for each soul judged rightly, and a tithe to Odin of {tithe} rings each night. ui.ragnarok.title: Ragnarök
ui.ragnarok.only: It fights there and nowhere else.
ui.ragnarok.rule: At its own front, each soul sent there rightly counts 2, and each sent there wrongly (to Valhalla: each unworthy soul) runs, costing the front 1. At any other front a soul counts 1.
ui.ragnarok.fronts: The fronts, in the order you'll hold them
ui.ragnarok.order: Each front is held if your hosts can hold it along with the ones above it. One that can't be held falls, and its host goes where it's needed.
ui.ragnarok.unfought: It wasn't fought: the run ended first.

ui.crash.title: Something went wrong
ui.crash.body: Nothing you've saved is lost: the game saves after every move. Reload to carry on from there. A Daily, Endless or campaign shift picks up at the soul you were on, paused.
ui.crash.holds: The report holds the build, the error, where you were in the game, and your browser, screen size and language. Nothing else.
ui.crash.textLabel: The problem report as text, to copy
ui.problem.note: Something went wrong. If the game stops responding, reload: nothing you've saved is lost.
ui.party.label: {n} souls who came together
coach.retinue: A jarl and his hearth-men. A man who stood by his jarl to the end, and never fled, goes where the jarl goes: judge the jarl, then turn each man over. The rules above that one still come first.
coach.party: These came together. Turn to each by name, or with [ and ]. What one says of another, Compare with that one's own body: a lie about a companion is a lie like any other. Stamp each and send it on; the last one sends them all.
coach.botch: That kenning isn't on the rulebook's page, and a skald never gets one wrong: a forger cut this tally. It counts for nothing.
